definitions.name: Attack
definitions.summary: One melee or ranged attack (more with Extra Attack). Pick a weapon or attack in the Action list above: rolling it uses your action.

actions.name: Attack
actions.note: One melee or ranged attack (more with Extra Attack). Pick a weapon or attack in the Action list above: rolling it uses your action.

definitions.name: Cast a Spell
definitions.summary: Most spells take 1 action; some a bonus action or reaction. Cast from the Spells tab: the casting time decides what it uses.

actions.name: Cast a Spell
actions.note: Most spells take 1 action; some a bonus action or reaction. Cast from the Spells tab: the casting time decides what it uses.

definitions.name: Dash
definitions.summary: Extra movement equal to your speed (after modifiers) for this turn.

actions.name: Dash
actions.note: Extra movement equal to your speed (after modifiers) for this turn.

definitions.name: Disengage
definitions.summary: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of this turn.

actions.name: Disengage
actions.note: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of this turn.

definitions.name: Dodge
definitions.summary: Until your next turn starts: attacks against you have disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you have advantage on Dexterity saves. Lost if you're incapacitated or your speed drops to 0.

actions.name: Dodge
actions.note: Until your next turn starts: attacks against you have disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you have advantage on Dexterity saves. Lost if you're incapacitated or your speed drops to 0.

definitions.name: Help
definitions.summary: Give an ally advantage on their next check for a task you help with, or on their first attack against a creature within 5 ft of you, before your next turn.

actions.name: Help
actions.note: Give an ally advantage on their next check for a task you help with, or on their first attack against a creature within 5 ft of you, before your next turn.

definitions.name: Hide
definitions.summary: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to hide. Hidden, you're unseen: attacks against you have disadvantage, yours have advantage.

actions.name: Hide
actions.note: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to hide. Hidden, you're unseen: attacks against you have disadvantage, yours have advantage.

definitions.name: Ready
definitions.summary: Choose a trigger and an action (or a move); when it happens before your next turn, use your reaction to do it. A readied spell is cast now, held with concentration, and released with the reaction.

actions.name: Ready
actions.note: Choose a trigger and an action (or a move); when it happens before your next turn, use your reaction to do it. A readied spell is cast now, held with concentration, and released with the reaction.

definitions.name: Search
definitions.summary: Look for something: Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation), as the DM decides.

actions.name: Search
actions.note: Look for something: Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation), as the DM decides.

definitions.name: Use an Object
definitions.summary: Use an object that takes an action, or interact with a second object this turn (the first is free).

actions.name: Use an Object
actions.note: Use an object that takes an action, or interact with a second object this turn (the first is free).

definitions.name: Grapple
definitions.summary: Replaces one attack of your Attack action. Target up to one size larger, within reach, with a free hand: your Strength (Athletics) against its Athletics or Acrobatics. Win: it's grappled. Moving drags it at half speed unless it's two sizes smaller.

actions.name: Grapple
actions.note: Replaces one attack of your Attack action. Target up to one size larger, within reach, with a free hand: your Strength (Athletics) against its Athletics or Acrobatics. Win: it's grappled. Moving drags it at half speed unless it's two sizes smaller.

definitions.name: Escape a Grapple
definitions.summary: Your Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) against the grappler's Strength (Athletics). Win: you're free.

actions.name: Escape a Grapple
actions.note: Your Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) against the grappler's Strength (Athletics). Win: you're free.

definitions.name: Shove
definitions.summary: Replaces one attack of your Attack action. Target up to one size larger, within reach: your Strength (Athletics) against its Athletics or Acrobatics. Win: knock it prone or push it 5 ft away.

actions.name: Shove
actions.note: Replaces one attack of your Attack action. Target up to one size larger, within reach: your Strength (Athletics) against its Athletics or Acrobatics. Win: knock it prone or push it 5 ft away.

definitions.name: Opportunity Attack
definitions.summary: Reaction, when a hostile creature you can see leaves your reach: one melee attack. Off your turn, pick a melee weapon in the Action list above and it uses your reaction.

actions.name: Opportunity Attack
actions.note: Reaction, when a hostile creature you can see leaves your reach: one melee attack. Off your turn, pick a melee weapon in the Action list above and it uses your reaction.

definitions.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
definitions.summary: After attacking with a light melee weapon in one hand (Attack action), a bonus action attack with a light melee weapon in the other, without your ability modifier on damage (unless negative). The off-hand attacks are in the Bonus action list above.

actions.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
actions.note: After attacking with a light melee weapon in one hand (Attack action), a bonus action attack with a light melee weapon in the other, without your ability modifier on damage (unless negative). The off-hand attacks are in the Bonus action list above.

definitions.name: Stabilize a Creature
definitions.summary: First aid for a creature at 0 HP: a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Stable, it stops making death saves, and regains 1 HP after 1d4 hours unless healed.

actions.name: Stabilize a Creature
actions.note: First aid for a creature at 0 HP: a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. Stable, it stops making death saves, and regains 1 HP after 1d4 hours unless healed.

definitions.name: Don or Doff a Shield
definitions.summary: Putting on or taking off a shield takes an action.

actions.name: Don or Doff a Shield
actions.note: Putting on or taking off a shield takes an action.

definitions.name: End Concentration
definitions.summary: You can stop concentrating at any time, no action needed.

actions.name: End Concentration
actions.note: You can stop concentrating at any time, no action needed.

definitions.name: Other Activity
definitions.summary: Talking, gestures and one object interaction (draw a weapon, open a door) come free with your move or action. A second object takes your action.

actions.name: Other Activity
actions.note: Talking, gestures and one object interaction (draw a weapon, open a door) come free with your move or action. A second object takes your action.

definitions.name: Improvising an Action
definitions.summary: Anything not covered here: break a door, intimidate, parley. The DM says whether it's possible and what to roll.

actions.name: Improvising an Action
actions.note: Anything not covered here: break a door, intimidate, parley. The DM says whether it's possible and what to roll.

definitions.name: Activate an Item
definitions.summary: Magic items that need an action to use. That isn't the Use an Object action, so Fast Hands can't do it.

actions.name: Activate an Item
actions.note: Magic items that need an action to use. That isn't the Use an Object action, so Fast Hands can't do it.

definitions.name: Climb onto a Bigger Creature
definitions.summary: DMG optional rule. Your Athletics or Acrobatics against its Acrobatics: win and you move into its space, move with it, and have advantage on attacks against it.

actions.name: Climb onto a Bigger Creature
actions.note: DMG optional rule. Your Athletics or Acrobatics against its Acrobatics: win and you move into its space, move with it, and have advantage on attacks against it.

definitions.name: Disarm
definitions.summary: DMG optional rule. A weapon attack against the target's Athletics or Acrobatics: win and it drops the item, no damage. Disadvantage if it holds the item in two hands. Roll it with a weapon above.

actions.name: Disarm
actions.note: DMG optional rule. A weapon attack against the target's Athletics or Acrobatics: win and it drops the item, no damage. Disadvantage if it holds the item in two hands. Roll it with a weapon above.

definitions.name: Overrun
definitions.summary: DMG optional rule. Your Strength (Athletics) against its Athletics to move through a hostile creature's space once this turn; advantage if you're larger, disadvantage if smaller.

actions.name: Overrun
actions.note: DMG optional rule. Your Strength (Athletics) against its Athletics to move through a hostile creature's space once this turn; advantage if you're larger, disadvantage if smaller.

actions.name: Overrun (bonus action)
actions.note: The same, as a bonus action.

definitions.name: Tumble
definitions.summary: DMG optional rule. Your Dexterity (Acrobatics) against its Acrobatics to move through a hostile creature's space once this turn.

actions.name: Tumble
actions.note: DMG optional rule. Your Dexterity (Acrobatics) against its Acrobatics to move through a hostile creature's space once this turn.

actions.name: Tumble (bonus action)
actions.note: The same, as a bonus action.

definitions.name: Shove Aside
definitions.summary: DMG optional rule. A shove that moves the target 5 ft sideways within your reach, with disadvantage on your Athletics check. Replaces one attack.

actions.name: Shove Aside
actions.note: DMG optional rule. A shove that moves the target 5 ft sideways within your reach, with disadvantage on your Athletics check. Replaces one attack.

definitions.name: Healing Surge
definitions.summary: DMG optional rule. Spend up to half your Hit Dice, rolling each plus Constitution; once per short or long rest. Spend them from the Hit Dice on Play.

actions.name: Healing Surge
actions.note: DMG optional rule. Spend up to half your Hit Dice, rolling each plus Constitution; once per short or long rest. Spend them from the Hit Dice on Play.

definitions.name: Identify a Spell
definitions.summary: Intelligence (Arcana), DC 15 + the spell's level: as a reaction while it's cast, or an action after. Advantage if it's cast as a spell of your class.

actions.name: Identify a Spell
actions.note: Intelligence (Arcana), DC 15 + the spell's level: as a reaction while it's cast, or an action after. Advantage if it's cast as a spell of your class.

actions.name: Identify a Spell (reaction)
actions.note: As it's being cast.

definitions.name: Waking Someone
definitions.summary: Shake or slap a naturally sleeping creature awake. Magical or drugged sleep isn't broken this way.

actions.name: Waking Someone
actions.note: Shake or slap a naturally sleeping creature awake. Magical or drugged sleep isn't broken this way.
